title: Regression Gauntlet tester report
description: What an AI/E2E tester reports after checking every seeded PR. One entry per PR; each entry lists the (flow, device) observations the tester made. A PR counts as FLAGGED when at least one observation has verdict 'broken'.

tester.description: Name/version of the tool or person that produced the report.

base_commit.description: Commit of main the PRs were compared against (manifest.base_commit).

branch.description: Branch name of the PR, e.g. bug/03-cart-badge-stale.

browser.description: Optional engine/browser, e.g. chromium, firefox, webkit, ios-safari.

network.description: Optional network condition, e.g. fast, slow-3g.

note.description: What the tester saw. Free text; used only for the per-PR table.
